## User need

Describe the task and its current difficulty. Prefer concrete operations over comparison with another application's appearance.

## Proposed behavior and acceptance criteria

Explain the expected result, important failure cases and how completion can be checked.

## Scope and constraints

Note relevant platform, data-preservation, lightweight-operation or compatibility requirements. A request for discussion does not authorize implementation, system changes or publication.
